text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school, hearing voices 
coming from the gym, I took a peek inside—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, pay more attention to the spotlight's 
position. You're starting to walk way too 
early.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! My pardon! My very own 
brilliance shone so radiantly that I 
failed to notice the spotlight's glare!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto, focus on moving that spotlight 
faster. You're not keeping up with Opera 
O's movements at all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees...! I'll do my best! Faster, even 
faster...!
choice_data_list: Air Shakur, you're doing a stage play!?
Air Shakur, you're doing a stage play!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No it's not, don't make stupid 
assumptions!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, the only one standing on stage is 
T.M. Opera O. Perhaps she's helping out 
backstage with the audio, lighting, or 
staging?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural to want to trap me in a 
cage called the spotlight! Oh, how 
frightening my own charm is, forcing the 
entire world to bend to my will...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
R-Right, exactly... Shakur-san is only 
helping because she was moved by Opera 
O-san's brilliance, after all...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hell no, that's completely wrong. Hey, how 
many times do I gotta deny this?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Stop asking me about every single thing, 
you're annoying...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, but if you're curious, come watch 
the run-through. I was just thinking we 
needed an audience factor anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, get ready. Code review starts 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was an opera crafted with such 
perfection that it was almost impossible 
to believe it had been made by only three 
people.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, I can never be satisfied 
with just any fleeting moment――I must 
convey my supreme beauty to as many people 
as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...3, 2, 1. Fade out in 10 seconds...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O walks beneath a pinpoint 
spotlight. The sound of footsteps echoing 
on cobblestone is courtesy of the 
acoustics.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when that thought crosses my mind, a 
vast ocean appears in the next moment. As 
the lights blaze to full power, the sound 
of crashing waves echoes, creating an 
entire world upon the bare stage—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Time, stand still! For I am beautiful!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...And here, fade to black.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That is all. Any thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Of course. That immersive feeling—I tuned 
everything meticulously so it'd pull the 
audience right onto the stage with me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that was an exquisite show! It 
brought out my dazzling charm even 
further— a truly brilliant production, 
like polishing a gemstone to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I had no clue how to set up the sound or 
lighting on my own... You've been a huge 
help~...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? I didn't do it to help you out. I 
was just proving my own theory."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All I wanted to know was whether my logic 
would hold up in an uncertain realm like 
"art"... That was all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk, we spent too long chatting. Right, 
we're gonna run test after test till the 
real deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Air Shakur was only helping to 
prove his own theories, not out of 
kindness. Even so—
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all, didn't you?
You've worked so hard, haven't you?
I'll help you right up until race day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Air Shakur was only helping to 
prove his own theories, not out of 
kindness. Even so—
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all, didn't you?
You've worked so hard, haven't you?
I'll help you right up until race day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Hah?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it lacked friendliness, polishing 
the performance to such a high level of 
perfection is no ordinary feat. When I 
conveyed that she must have put in a 
tremendous amount of effort—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't try to brush it off with some cliché 
expression. Delivering the performance 
needed to achieve your goal is the bare 
minimum, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"U-Umm... but Shakur-san joined my 
practices so many times... and it's true 
that we worked hard together—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, um, I know it sounds rich coming from 
someone as useless as me, but...! I'm so 
sorryyy...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Haa. What a pain in the ass.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Either way, not a bad result. If you can 
keep up this quality until the real deal, 
I'll invite you back to play audience 
again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it was hard to tell, Air Shakur 
seemed just a little bit pleased.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Well, of course. If I threw it away 
now, Doto would just sob and wail at me 
endlessly.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I certainly would have gone to 
recruit you as well! Stagehands as 
wonderful as you are hard to come by! 
There's no way I would have let you get 
away, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...See? It was simply more rational to 
stick together till the very end. I 
factored that in from the start.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I've got no ulterior motive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing something through to the end means 
you're actually quite caring, isn't it? 
This incident certainly made me feel that 
way!
